questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections where oncoming traffic makes U-turns unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed when approaching a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep downhill slope. Reduce your speed to prevent brake damage and accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move left to continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left-turning vehicles. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow-green warning sign alerts you to a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes or shift your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a reverse curve. The road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows the recommended speed for the curve ahead. Slow down to 35 mph or less before entering the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs indicate a school zone or school crossing ahead. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottoms of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You could face a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. Drivers must follow the rules on these signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road turns sharply right and then sharply left ahead.
